name: semantic-js-mcp
description: Read-only semantic navigation for JavaScript ecosystem projects through MCP.

interface.longDescription: Adds read-only, workspace-aware TypeScript, JavaScript, Node module, JSX, TSX, and Vue evidence using language servers, complete reference accounting, reusable paged collections, actionable unresolved candidates, and versioned diagnostics.
defaultPrompt: Trace this TypeScript symbol and its callers.
Review this change using semantic references.
Check focused diagnostics for the edited files.
